title: Personal Website
description: A personal website to showcase a little bit about my life and skills
details: I first built this website using raw HTML and CSS. After my first iteration, I migrated everything over to Svelte to increase the development speed. I chose to deploy to Cloudflare Workers for its built-in security, automatic scaling, cost effectiveness, and easy CI/CD GitHub integration.

about: This was a project to test the security vulnerabilities of Amazon purchased baby monitor cameras.
